techniques.name: Phishing
techniques.description: Adversaries send messages to get a user to open a link or attachment.

techniques.name: Spearphishing Attachment
techniques.description: A targeted message carries a malicious file.

techniques.name: Spearphishing Link
techniques.description: A targeted message carries a link to a credential or payload site.

techniques.name: Exploit Public-Facing Application
techniques.description: Adversaries exploit a bug in an internet-facing service.

techniques.name: Valid Accounts
techniques.description: Adversaries use real credentials to get in or stay in.

techniques.name: Command and Scripting Interpreter
techniques.description: Adversaries abuse shells and scripts to run commands.

techniques.name: PowerShell
techniques.description: Commands run through PowerShell.

techniques.name: Process Injection
techniques.description: Code runs inside another process to hide.

techniques.name: Obfuscated Files or Information
techniques.description: Payloads are encoded or packed to avoid inspection.

techniques.name: Application Layer Protocol
techniques.description: Command traffic blends into normal application protocols.

techniques.name: Web Protocols
techniques.description: C2 over HTTP or HTTPS.

techniques.name: Ingress Tool Transfer
techniques.description: Tools are copied onto a compromised host.

techniques.name: Exfiltration Over C2 Channel
techniques.description: Stolen data leaves over the same channel used for commands.

techniques.name: Data Encrypted for Impact
techniques.description: Ransomware encrypts data to deny access.

techniques.name: Brute Force
techniques.description: Repeated guesses against a login.

techniques.name: Acquire Infrastructure
techniques.description: Adversaries buy or rent servers, domains, or accounts.

techniques.name: Domains
techniques.description: Domains are registered for phishing or C2.

techniques.name: OS Credential Dumping
techniques.description: Credentials are pulled from the operating system.

techniques.name: Scheduled Task/Job
techniques.description: Execution is tied to a scheduler.

techniques.name: System Binary Proxy Execution
techniques.description: A trusted signed binary launches something else.

groups.name: APT28
groups.description: A long-running group associated with phishing and credential theft.

groups.name: APT29
groups.description: A group known for stealthy intrusions and valid-account use.

groups.name: Kimsuky
groups.description: A group that leans on spearphishing against research and government targets.

groups.name: FIN7
groups.description: A financially motivated group that has used phishing and point-of-sale intrusions.

software.name: QakBot
software.description: A modular loader and stealer that has used email threads and C2 infrastructure.

software.name: Emotet
software.description: A botnet and loader historically delivered by email.

software.name: BitPaymer
software.description: Ransomware that encrypts files for impact.

software.name: PowerShell
